title: AWS Lambda Web Function with private VPC egress
description: Run a Lambda Web Function that reaches private resources in your VPC through a Lambda network connector

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template creates a Lambda network connector that provisions elastic network interfaces (ENIs) in your VPC subnets and security groups, a Lambda Web Function, and an immutable revision whose ServiceConfig.EgressNetworkConnectorArn references the connector's version-qualified ARN so outbound traffic is routed through your VPC. An IamAuth HomeRegion endpoint routes traffic to the revision. Because a revision with a network connector supports only HomeRegion endpoints, multi-Region endpoint types are not used in this pattern. The sample Node.js HTTP server optionally probes a private INTERNAL_TARGET_URL to demonstrate reaching resources inside the VPC.
See the GitHub repo for detailed build and deploy instructions.
